note: Rejudged at HEAD after checkPPPCodeReject replaced fail(7, parseErr) with pppCodeRejectFailure(name, 7, parseErr) inside Wait callbacks (identical behavior). Re-read RFC 1661 Section 5.6: 'The Rejected-Packet MUST be truncated to comply with the peer's established MRU.' Positive TestRFC1661CodeRejectTruncatedToMRU sends 404-octet LCP and IPCP unknown-code packets with negotiatedMRU 100 and asserts exact 100-octet Information field, preserved Code/Identifier/original Length 404, and first 92 octets of Data. Negative TestRFC1661CodeRejectKeptWhenItFits sends a 44-octet LCP packet with negotiatedMRU 100 and asserts all 44 octets stay intact. Interop checkPPPCodeReject assertion 4 enforces rejectsWithinMRU for 204-octet probes under MRU 128. Producer writeCodeReject clamps to min(frameLen(transmitMRU), MaxFrameBufLen). Verdict stands.
